senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. preced. wds., [to withhold, prevent, v.
to muzzle, esp. to prevent the animal from eating while at work (with ref. to Deut. XXV, 4).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 90a:15">B. Mets. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>עובר משום בל תַּחְסוֹם</he> he trespasses the law forbidding to muzzle (if he prevents the animal from eating).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 90a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>חֲסוֹם פרתי</he> muzzle my cow.

Ib.ᵇ, a. e. חֲסָמָהּ בקול if he prevents her from eating by shouting at her; a. fr.—Trnsf. (an adaptation of Deut. l. c. which is followed by the law concerning leviratical marriage) to tie a woman to a man (Yabam) with whom she cannot live; [Rashi: to shut a woman’s mouth, ignore her objections].
<cite ref="Yevamot 4a:3">Yeb. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>שאין חוֹסְמִין אותה</he> that we do not coërce her (to be the wife of a leper).

senses.gloss: to form the rim of basket work or of a leather bag.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:2">Kel. XVI, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:3">3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:4">4</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be muzzled, to be prevented from eating while at work.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 89a:2">B. Mets. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>לאקושי חוֹסֵם לנֶחְסָם וכ׳</he> to draw a parallel between the muzzler (human laborer) and the muzzled (laboring brute).
